segments.text:
All your calamities will have an end shortly.
The longest day of the Saints troubles hath an
end; and then, no more troubles for ever. The
troubles of the wicked will be to Eternity; but
you shall suffer but a while, 1 Pet. 5. 10. If a
thousand troubles be appointed for you, they
will come to one at last, and after that no more:
Yea, and though our troubles be but for a moment,
yet they work for us a far more exceeding
and eternal weight of glory. Let that support
your hearts under all your sufferings.
